description: This file contains JavaScript functions for managing line items, including products and services, in a CRM module. It handles dynamic UI updates, calculations, and interactions for adding, deleting, and calculating totals for line items within grouped sections in a CRM quote or invoice module.

methods.name: insertLineItems
methods.description: Loads line items into the UI, creating product or service lines within groups based on provided data.

methods.name: insertProductLine
methods.description: Creates a new product line in the specified table, with fields for quantity, name, part number, prices, VAT, total, and descriptions.

methods.name: insertServiceLine
methods.description: Creates a new service line in the specified table, with fields for name, price, discount, VAT, total, and delete button.

methods.name: insertProductHeader
methods.description: Inserts header row for product lines with column labels.

methods.name: insertServiceHeader
methods.description: Inserts header row for service lines with column labels.

methods.name: insertGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group container with nested product and service tables, including totals and delete options.

methods.name: markGroupDeleted
methods.description: Hides a group and marks all its lines as deleted.

methods.name: markLineDeleted
methods.description: Hides a line item and marks it as deleted, then recalculates totals.

methods.name: calculateLine
methods.description: Calculates prices, VAT, and total for a specific line item based on quantity, discounts, and VAT rate.

methods.name: calculateAllLines
methods.description: Recalculates all product and service lines in all groups.

methods.name: calculateTotal
methods.description: Calculates totals, discounts, taxes, and subtotals for a group or the entire line items section.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Sets the value of an input element by ID, formatted as number.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Retrieves and unformats the number value from an input element by ID.

methods.name: unformat2Number
methods.description: Converts formatted number string to numeric value.

methods.name: format2Number
methods.description: Formats a number into a string with proper thousand separators and decimal points.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a number into a currency string with commas and two decimal places.

methods.name: Quantity_format2Number
methods.description: Formats quantity input value into a number string, removing unnecessary zeros.

methods.name: check_form
methods.description: Validates the form before submission, recalculating all lines first.
